scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,bff,python "pnpm --filter @enterprise/web dev" "pnpm --filter @enterprise/bff dev" "uv run --directory services/backend python -m enterprise_agent"
scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && uv run --directory services/backend ruff check .
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --directory services/backend ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --directory services/backend ruff format --check .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @enterprise/web test && pnpm --filter @enterprise/bff test && uv run --directory services/backend pytest
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory services/backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --directory services/backend python -m enterprise_agent.export_openapi && pnpm --filter @enterprise/bff contracts:generate
